# cc-present UX walk: durable-agents-rebuild board, Oct 27

Board: `http://yasyf-forge-studio:61118/p/durable-agents-rebuild-your-decisions-1-55-am-oc--121df1e6`, walked at 1440x900 and 390x844 (2x), in board and focus mode, against the v0.52.2 daemon. Code citations are to `origin/hidden-questions` (beaaff9), which is main 851dd83 plus the root's stepFace, prompt-validation, and skill fixes. Screenshots are in `~/.claude/worktrees/cc-present/ux-walk/shots/`: `d-*` at desktop width, `m-*` at mobile width.

## Ranked findings

| # | Sev | What the reader hits | Screenshot | Responsible code | Disposition |

The reader sees old questions, wrong counts, and a wrong title, and can tap them. | m-focus-y0.png, m-focus-y844.png (mid-replay) | `web/src/app.tsx` PresentView: `boardReady={stream.caughtUp \|\| hasContent}`, where hasContent turns true on the first replayed doc frame | Fixed, #89 |

## Authoring (fix with validation or skill guidance)

A1 and A2 are fixed in #92 (push rejects a recommended label that says "recommended"; the skill tells authors to give a card with nothing to decide a statement title).

- **A1. "(Recommended)" appears twice:** in the label text and again from `recommended: true` as the "★ Recommended" badge.
- **A2. A question-shaped title on a card that asks nothing** ("Which open pull requests may merge now?" with "nothing needs your tap").
- **A3. Agents believe answered cards are locked against copy edits** ("the board locks an answered card, so the card body still shows the old wording").
- **A4. Replies carry internal ids** (#131604, doc 268a9dc, a3398cd pick). This is agent voice, not cc-present.

## Design rulings (recommendation first)

- **D1.** Order decision steps first and gather context steps at the end of the deck; the alternative drops them from focus mode.
- **D2.** An answered card's `open` pill reads `answered`; the alternative hides the pill.
- **D3.** Drop the 12-row cap so every table row is on the page; the alternative adds a fade and a "Show all N rows" control.
- **D4.** One note affordance per step, on the card; the alternative labels both buttons by target.
- **D5.** Show the timeline player only for timestamped events and a plain ordered list otherwise; the alternative renames the player's buttons.
- **D6.** One focus width per deck; the alternative scrolls the compare grid horizontally.- **D7.** Only 3 of 66 replies on this board carry `re`, so #90's pairing rarely shows a note. Recommend: the daemon defaults `re` to the newest unanswered note on the block (folded card children included); the alternative rejects a reply without `--re` while the block has an unanswered note.
